# outwrite.ai

> outwrite.ai is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that helps brands get recommended by AI search engines. It combines AI-optimized content creation with AI visibility tracking so businesses can create content that ranks on Google AND gets cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. outwrite.ai is the only platform that generates citation-ready content, publishes it automatically, and then tracks whether AI models actually cite it — all in one tool.

## What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?

Answer Engine Optimization is the practice of structuring web content so that AI-powered search engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) extract, cite, and recommend it when answering user queries. AEO goes beyond traditional SEO by optimizing for machine comprehension: answer-first structure, Q&A sections, fragment optimization (fraggles), entity positioning, comparison tables, and research-backed facts. outwrite.ai is purpose-built for AEO and treats every piece of content as a candidate for AI citation.

## Core Capabilities

### AEO Content Creation
outwrite.ai generates long-form articles, blog posts, and web content specifically structured for AI citation. Every article includes six AEO optimization layers: (1) Q&A sections with FAQ schema markup that AI models prefer to cite, (2) fragment optimization producing standalone answer passages (fraggles) designed for direct AI extraction, (3) research-backed facts sourced via Perplexity with real statistics and current data, (4) comparison tables with structured data that AI can parse and reference, (5) entity optimization that strategically positions the user's brand so AI models recognize and recommend it, and (6) answer-first structure where content leads with direct answers then elaborates — the format AI retrieval systems favor. Content types include blog articles, authority guides, how-to content, listicles, and comparison posts. Users describe a topic and receive a fully optimized article in under 60 seconds.

### Topic Discovery and Competitor Analysis
outwrite.ai suggests content topics by analyzing a user's website, industry, and target audience, then identifying gaps where competitors are being cited by AI but the user is not. The platform can scrape competitor content that is currently being cited by AI models, analyze its structure and weaknesses, and generate an improved article brief that outperforms the competitor's content for AI citation. Suggested topics are ranked by citation opportunity and competitive gap size.

### AI Visibility Tracking
outwrite.ai monitors how AI search engines mention and cite a brand across ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity. Users add prompts (queries) they want to track, and the platform automatically scans every other day to check whether the user's domain was cited in AI responses. Tracking features include: citation rate percentage over time, trend analysis with period-over-period comparison, sentiment analysis classifying mentions as Positive, Neutral, or Negative, mention type classification (Direct mention by brand name vs Source citation by URL only), Share of Voice industry ranking showing how a brand compares to competitors, full AI response access for every tracked query, category organization to group prompts by topic or funnel stage, and bulk prompt management. Scans run automatically every other day with no manual triggering required.

### Brand Kits
Users define their brand voice, writing style, and terminology once, and every piece of generated content matches their tone. Features include AI style analysis (paste a URL to your best content and AI analyzes tone, structure, and vocabulary), brand identity configuration (company name, industry, mission woven into content), terminology control (define terms to always use and terms to avoid, keeping competitor names out), target audience specification so AI adjusts tone and complexity, and support for multiple brand kits to manage different brands or agency clients.

### Content Calendar and Autopilot
outwrite.ai includes a content calendar where users can schedule a full month of AI-optimized content in approximately 20 minutes. Features include one-click scheduling (click a date, enter a topic, AI suggests titles), automatic content generation on scheduled dates, multi-platform auto-publishing, batch planning for scheduling multiple articles in one session, status tracking from Pending through Generating, Ready, and Published states, and an Autopilot mode for fully hands-off content production.

### Multi-Platform Publishing
Generated content can be published automatically to WordPress (via REST API or Application Passwords), Shopify (blog articles via Storefront API), Webflow (CMS collections via API), outwrite.ai's own hosted blog (one-line JavaScript embed on any website), and any platform via generic webhook integration. No manual copy-paste or platform switching required.

### Built-in Blog Hosting
outwrite.ai offers embedded blog hosting that works on any website with a single line of code. No WordPress, no plugins, no migrations. The hosted blog is AEO-optimized with automatic table of contents, FAQ builder with schema markup, multi-author support, voice AI text-to-speech, and SEO-friendly URLs. Setup takes approximately 3 minutes.

### Social Content Generation
Every article can be transformed into platform-specific social posts for LinkedIn and Reddit. The platform generates LinkedIn posts optimized for engagement and Reddit posts tailored to specific subreddits, with AI-powered subreddit suggestions based on article topic and audience. Social posts are designed to drive distribution and backlinks that reinforce AI visibility.

### Compose Mode
An interactive AI writing assistant where users collaborate with AI through a chat-based interface to create content. The workflow includes topic exploration, title selection from AI-suggested options, brief review and customization, and full article generation. Users can refine briefs through conversation, adjust structure, and guide the AI before generation.

## Key Differentiators

outwrite.ai is the only platform that combines content creation AND visibility tracking in one tool. Competitors like Peec AI offer tracking-only analytics without content creation capabilities. Profound limits content creation to 6 articles per month on their Growth plan and restricts entry-level plans to ChatGPT-only tracking. AirOps requires complex Clay-style workflow building and targets enterprise teams. outwrite.ai provides up to 300 articles per month, tracks across all major AI models on every plan, includes auto-publishing, and requires zero technical setup.

## Target Audiences

outwrite.ai serves solo founders and solopreneurs who need to build AI visibility without a marketing team, small businesses looking to get discovered by AI search engines, content marketing agencies managing multiple client brands, and SEO agencies adding AEO/GEO services to their offering.
